Strategic Priority - Resilient and Future Ready Organization
PDL-CAS-24-006, Region of Waterloo’s Lobbyist Registry
notes:
Nora Emtesali, Lobbyist Registry and Program/Policy Advisor, provided a presentation on the Lobbyist Registry, a copy of which is attached to the original agenda. She outlined the timeline, purpose, and alignment of the registry with the Region's Strategic Plan to foster a resilient, future-ready organization, emphasizing its role as an accountability and transparency tool.

The Committee discussed the anticipated tax impact of the program in 2025, as well as its overall cost and budget considerations.

In response to a Committee question, Will Short, Regional Clerk, clarified that while the Region would not be funding the program for other municipalities, support would be available from N. Emtesali should other municipalities express interest or require assistance in the future.

items.title: COR-CFN-24-021, Q3 2024 Plan and Financial Update
notes:
Wayne Steffler, Commissioner of Corporate Services and Chief Financial Officer, presented the report, noting that preliminary estimates for user rates indicate projected surpluses of $1.8 million for water and $7.1 million for wastewater, primarily due to increased flows. He also highlighted that the Region’s 2024 capital program, totaling $669 million (excluding Police Services), is progressing well. Based on current spending estimates, approximately 74% of the budget is expected to be spent by year-end.

In response to a Committee question, Doug Spooner, Commissioner of Transportation, explained that Grand River Transit (GRT) employs a combination of MobilityPLUS vehicles, which are owned by the Region, and accessible taxis. He noted a trend toward the use of larger mobility devices and assured the Committee that staff remain committed to accommodating these needs through both MobilityPLUS vehicles and taxis.

motions.text: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo take the following action with respect to the 2024 third quarter update as set out in report COR-CFN-24-021 dated November 5, 2024: Receive the 2024 Third Quarter Update that shows implementation and financial progress towards delivery on the Region’s Annual Business Plan, in support of achieving the vision set out by Council in the Growing with Care 2023-2027 Strategic Plan; and Amend the 2024 Capital Budget and 2025-2035 Capital Forecast as set out in Appendix D.

That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo take the following action with respect to the 2024 third quarter update as set out in report COR-CFN-24-021 dated November 5, 2024:  

  1. Receive the 2024 Third Quarter Update that shows implementation and financial progress towards delivery on the Region’s Annual Business Plan, in support of achieving the vision set out by Council in the Growing with Care 2023-2027 Strategic Plan; and 
  2. Amend the 2024 Capital Budget and 2025-2035 Capital Forecast as set out in Appendix D.
